content:
Specify the exact duration and aspect ratio in the prompt (e.g., Create a 30-second … commercial in 16:9) to control output format.  
Add a consistency constraint like Keep the same stylist and the same customer throughout the entire video to maintain character continuity across shots.  
Include a focus directive such as The customer is always the main focus to keep framing centered on the subject.  
Write a timecoded shot list (e.g., [0:00–0:04], [0:04–0:07], etc.) with explicit actions and dialogue to structure the video into clear scenes.  
Add pacing rules like Show only one salon action at a time, No fast cuts, No time-lapse, No jump cuts to enforce slower, readable edits.  
Request specific visual style modifiers (modern retro-anime style 3D-cel hybrid, soft VHS grain, synthwave color glow, warm cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field) to lock in the aesthetic.  
Explicitly ask for motion/animation qualities (cinematic slow camera movement, realistic soft hair physics, gentle hand animation, expressive close-up facial animation) to improve realism.  
Include negative constraints like no glitches, no subtitles, no watermark to reduce common artifacts.

es.content:
Especifica la duración exacta y la relación de aspecto en el prompt (por ejemplo, Create a 30-second … commercial in 16:9) para controlar el formato de salida.  
Añade una restricción de consistencia como Keep the same stylist and the same customer throughout the entire video para mantener la continuidad de los personajes entre planos.  
Incluye una directiva de enfoque como The customer is always the main focus para mantener el encuadre centrado en el sujeto.  
Escribe una lista de planos con timecodes (por ejemplo, [0:00–0:04], [0:04–0:07], etc.) con acciones y diálogos explícitos para estructurar el video en escenas claras.  
Añade reglas de ritmo como Show only one salon action at a time, No fast cuts, No time-lapse, No jump cuts para imponer ediciones más lentas y legibles.  
Solicita modificadores específicos de estilo visual (modern retro-anime style 3D-cel hybrid, soft VHS grain, synthwave color glow, warm cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field) para fijar la estética.  
Pide explícitamente cualidades de movimiento/animación (cinematic slow camera movement, realistic soft hair physics, gentle hand animation, expressive close-up facial animation) para mejorar el realismo.  
Incluye restricciones negativas como no glitches, no subtitles, no watermark para reducir artefactos comunes.

fr.content:
Précisez la durée exacte et le format d’image dans le prompt (par exemple, Create a 30-second … commercial in 16:9) afin de contrôler le format de sortie.  
Ajoutez une contrainte de cohérence comme Keep the same stylist and the same customer throughout the entire video pour maintenir la continuité des personnages d’un plan à l’autre.  
Incluez une directive de focus telle que The customer is always the main focus pour garder le cadrage centré sur le sujet.  
Rédigez une liste de plans horodatée (par exemple, [0:00–0:04], [0:04–0:07], etc.) avec des actions et des dialogues explicites pour structurer la vidéo en scènes claires.  
Ajoutez des règles de rythme comme Show only one salon action at a time, No fast cuts, No time-lapse, No jump cuts pour imposer un montage plus lent et lisible.  
Demandez des modificateurs de style visuel précis (modern retro-anime style 3D-cel hybrid, soft VHS grain, synthwave color glow, warm cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field) pour verrouiller l’esthétique.  
Demandez explicitement des qualités de mouvement/d’animation (cinematic slow camera movement, realistic soft hair physics, gentle hand animation, expressive close-up facial animation) pour améliorer le réalisme.  
Incluez des contraintes négatives comme no glitches, no subtitles, no watermark pour réduire les artefacts courants.

ja.content:
プロンプト内で正確な長さとアスペクト比を指定します（例: 16:9で30秒の…広告を作成する）ことで、出力フォーマットを制御できます。  
「動画全体を通して同じスタイリストと同じ顧客を維持する」といった一貫性の制約を加え、ショット間でキャラクターの連続性を保ちます。  
「顧客が常に主役である」といったフォーカス指示を入れて、フレーミングが被写体中心になるようにします。  
タイムコード付きのショットリスト（例: [0:00–0:04]、[0:04–0:07] など）を、明確なアクションとセリフ付きで記述し、動画をわかりやすいシーンに構成します。  
「一度に見せるサロンのアクションは1つだけ」「高速カットなし」「タイムラプスなし」「ジャンプカットなし」といったテンポに関するルールを加え、よりゆっくりで見やすい編集を徹底します。  
特定のビジュアルスタイル修飾子（modern retro-anime style 3D-cel hybrid、soft VHS grain、synthwave color glow、warm cinematic lighting、shallow depth of field）を指定して、美学を固定します。  
motion/animation の質についても明示的に指定し（cinematic slow camera movement、realistic soft hair physics、gentle hand animation、expressive close-up facial animation）、リアリズムを高めます。  
no glitches、no subtitles、no watermark などのネガティブ制約を含め、よくあるアーティファクトを減らします。

ko.content:
프롬프트에서 정확한 길이와 화면 비율을 지정하세요(예: 16:9 비율의 30초짜리 광고를 제작하세요)하여 출력 형식을 제어합니다.  
전체 영상에서 같은 스타일리스트와 같은 고객을 유지하라는 일관성 제약을 추가하여 샷 간 캐릭터 연속성을 유지하세요.  
고객이 항상 주요 초점이 되도록 하는 등 초점 지시를 포함하여 구도가 피사체 중심으로 유지되게 하세요.  
명확한 장면 구성을 위해 시간 코드가 포함된 샷 리스트(예: [0:00–0:04], [0:04–0:07] 등)를 작성하고, 각 샷마다 구체적인 동작과 대사를 넣으세요.  
Show only one salon action at a time, No fast cuts, No time-lapse, No jump cuts와 같은 페이싱 규칙을 추가하여 더 느리고 읽기 쉬운 편집을 유도하세요.  
현대적 레트로-애니메 스타일의 3D-cel 하이브리드, 부드러운 VHS 그레인, 신스웨이브 컬러 글로우, 따뜻한 시네마틱 조명, 얕은 심도와 같은 구체적인 비주얼 스타일 수식어를 요청하여 미학을 고정하세요.  
cinematic slow camera movement, realistic soft hair physics, gentle hand animation, expressive close-up facial animation과 같은 모션/애니메이션 특성을 명시적으로 요청하여 사실감을 높이세요.  
no glitches, no subtitles, no watermark와 같은 네거티브 제약을 포함하여 흔한 아티팩트를 줄이세요.

pt.content:
Especifique a duração exata e a proporção de aspecto no prompt (por exemplo, Create a 30-second … commercial in 16:9) para controlar o formato de saída.  
Adicione uma restrição de consistência, como Keep the same stylist and the same customer throughout the entire video, para manter a continuidade dos personagens entre os planos.  
Inclua uma diretriz de foco, como The customer is always the main focus, para manter o enquadramento centralizado no sujeito.  
Escreva uma shot list com marcação de tempo (por exemplo, [0:00–0:04], [0:04–0:07], etc.) com ações e diálogos explícitos para estruturar o vídeo em cenas claras.  
Adicione regras de ritmo, como Show only one salon action at a time, No fast cuts, No time-lapse, No jump cuts, para impor edições mais lentas e fáceis de acompanhar.  
Solicite modificadores visuais específicos de estilo (modern retro-anime style 3D-cel hybrid, soft VHS grain, synthwave color glow, warm cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field) para fixar a estética.  
Peça explicitamente qualidades de movimento/animação (cinematic slow camera movement, realistic soft hair physics, gentle hand animation, expressive close-up facial animation) para melhorar o realismo.  
Inclua restrições negativas como no glitches, no subtitles, no watermark para reduzir artefatos comuns.

zh.content:
在提示词中明确指定准确的时长和宽高比（例如：Create a 30-second … commercial in 16:9），以控制输出格式。  
添加一致性约束，例如 Keep the same stylist and the same customer throughout the entire video，以保持不同镜头之间的角色连续性。  
加入聚焦指令，例如 The customer is always the main focus，以确保构图始终围绕主体。  
编写带时间码的 shot list（例如：[0:00–0:04]、[0:04–0:07] 等），并附上明确的动作和对白，将视频结构化为清晰的场景。  
添加节奏规则，例如 Show only one salon action at a time, No fast cuts, No time-lapse, No jump cuts，以强制采用更慢、更易读的剪辑。  
请求特定的视觉风格修饰词（modern retro-anime style 3D-cel hybrid, soft VHS grain, synthwave color glow, warm cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field），以锁定整体美学。  
明确要求运动/动画质量（cinematic slow camera movement, realistic soft hair physics, gentle hand animation, expressive close-up facial animation），以提升真实感。  
加入负面约束，例如 no glitches, no subtitles, no watermark，以减少常见瑕疵。
